musicbrainz.identity_caveat: Metadata matches are candidates, not fingerprint-verified local recordings. Do not infer the local recording's live/remix/version status from a candidate alone. Artist tags describe the artist, not necessarily this track. Missing vocal credits do not establish instrumental status.
